findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/worktree-ensure.ts::a build-progress read exit other than 0 or 3 falls through to the hold check like exit 3
findings.title: A build-progress read exit other than 0 or 3 falls through to the hold check like exit 3
findings.action: No change: the spec routes only exit 0 to the resume check; any other exit reaches the hold check, which needs labels and a held store before anything is read.
findings.disposition_rationale: build-progress read exits only 0, 3 or 2 (usage); a usage fault there is unreachable with the arguments the command builds.

occurrences.title: A build-progress read exit other than 0 or 3 falls through to the hold check like exit 3

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/worktree-ensure.ts::unbounded git fetch in the rebase and recreate paths
findings.title: Unbounded git fetch in the rebase and recreate paths
findings.action: Both fetches now run through gitNet: FAFF_GIT_NET_TIMEOUT (default 30s) with SIGKILL, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 and an ssh BatchMode/ConnectTimeout/ServerAlive bound unless GIT_SSH_COMMAND is set; tests cover a killed fetch and a black-holed ssh origin.

occurrences.title: Unbounded git fetch in the rebase and recreate paths

findings.finding_id: docs/guide/cli.md::exit 2 fires after the conventions cache write, and a label-config failure exits 2
findings.title: Exit 2 fires after the conventions cache write, and a label-config failure exits 2
findings.action: The doc row now says exit 2 comes before any worktree is created and names an unresolvable label configuration.
findings.disposition_rationale: The order (conventions mine at step 1, labels at step 4) is the spec's own; only the doc overclaimed.

occurrences.title: Exit 2 fires after the conventions cache write, and a label-config failure exits 2

findings.title: Store restore runs before recreate
findings.disposition_rationale: Spec section 4.1 step 4 orders restore before recreate; restore refuses occupied run-dir folders and each drain mints a fresh run dir, so a parked recreate does not block the next drain.

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/worktree-ensure.ts::an exit-0 restore with an unparseable record degrades a dialogue hold to gate
findings.title: An exit-0 restore with an unparseable record degrades a dialogue hold to gate
findings.action: A restore record without a string cause is now needs-human store-restore-failed:0, before any recreate; test added.
findings.disposition_rationale: Never silently drop the dialogue counters the hold limit depends on.

occurrences.title: An exit-0 restore with an unparseable record degrades a dialogue hold to gate

findings.title: verifyCheckpoint treats a git failure as a hash mismatch
findings.disposition_rationale: Spec section 4.1 step 3 and prose rule 23: a ref that does not resolve or a hash that does not match is checkpoint-mismatch and a fresh rebuild, which fails safe.

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/worktree-ensure.ts::toctou between the registered-worktree check and git worktree add
findings.title: TOCTOU between the registered-worktree check and git worktree add
findings.disposition_rationale: The losing peer's add fails into resume-recreate-failed (park); the build claim is the mutex that prevents two peers resuming one issue.
